files_changed.summary: Prototype layout: header with stage meta, Relatórios and Novo diagnóstico; DraftCard with 'Continuar de onde parei' when a draft exists; focal ReevaluationCountdown + OwnerFollowUpWidgets grid; 'Suas 3 ações' reusing TrackedActionRows (editable status with undo, AC-ra-26); result/compare links. Removed StagePlate, Evolution and every trend use.

'Refazer o diagnóstico': 'N dias até {data}' / 'N dias de atraso desde {data}' via shared/domain/followUp reevaluationCountdown, interval 'a cada N dias', Último/Hoje/Próximo line via reevaluationTimeline with a progress bar, the lock (home-trava), and the in-app-only reminder sentence.

'Ações do plano' (feitas, em andamento, a fazer, não se aplica, vencidas chip), 'Diário de números' (cost per customer via formatMoney + months noted / measured range), 'Relatórios' (last saved PDF or invitation); each row is a Link to /empresa/:id/acoes | diario | relatorios.
File deleted; nothing imports ScoreTrend or HomeTrendPoint.

5-step prototype tour (relatorios, marca, acoes, diario, modo) for both modes; each step opens its page (company tab of the focus company or first active company, /configuracoes, current page for modo); TOUR_VERSION=2; auto-opens once on #/inicio when tourSeenVersion < 2 and the home shows content; skip/finish/leave saves {tourSeenVersion: 2, tourSeen: {[mode]: true}}; '?' reopens via useTour().openTour.
Unchanged; its TrackedActionRows export already provides the editable row used by 'Suas 3 ações'.

findings.summary: Phase-level checks were not run in this unit: pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts and the Play dev-link walkthrough. They are integration evidence after all producers finish (the e2e specs are owned by other units and still describe the v1 tour).

src/App.tsx has no child route 'relatorios' under empresa/:companyId (only relatorios/carteira), so the home 'Relatórios' links, the 'Relatórios' widget and tour step 1 land on a non-routed path until the report center route is wired. App.tsx is being edited concurrently by phase-4-frontend-diary; not touched here.

Tour anchors data-aioson-tour='relatorios' (report preview), 'marca' (brand section) and 'modo' (mode toggle) do not exist in the files that own those regions. The tour falls back to data-aioson-id report-preview / tab-relatorios, brand-section and mode-toggle / mode-chip / nav; mode-chip is hidden below sm, so on 390 px the last step falls back to nav or a centered card.

messages.text: Run: pnpm build; pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts; then in the Play dev-link mark an overdue action as Feita, change the interval and switch modes, checking both homes' numbers change. Owner home ids: home-reeval (data-state late|on-time), home-reeval-count, home-reeval-interval, home-reeval-timeline, home-reeval-reminder, home-trava, home-widgets, home-actions-widget(-value|-sub), home-actions-overdue, home-diary-widget(-value|-sub), home-reports-widget(-value|-sub), home-actions, home-actions-list, home-actions-open, home-draft, home-continue-draft, home-reports, home-new-diag, home-see-result, home-compare. Removed: escada/StagePlate, home-evolution, result-actions on the home.

Tour v2 behavior differs from what tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts checks: the '?' no longer navigates to #/inicio; step 1 opens /empresa/:focusId/relatorios, step 2 /configuracoes, step 3 /empresa/:id/acoes, step 4 /empresa/:id/diario, step 5 stays (anchor modo). It is the same 5 steps in both modes (the 4-step consultant tour is gone, which also resolves the 'mais de 90 dias' copy note). Seen state is tourSeenVersion >= 2; closing still also sets tourSeen[mode]=true. Auto-open waits for home-owner or home-consultant plus a known company. walkTour's 'tour-highlight visible' needs each anchor rendered: wire the empresa/:companyId/relatorios route and ideally add data-aioson-tour='relatorios' | 'marca' | 'modo' on the report preview, the brand section and the mode switch.

The owner widget counts come from GET /api/home and are read again on each opening (HomePage reloads on mount); changing a status in 'Suas 3 ações' updates the row at once but the 'Ações do plano' counts change on the next opening, as AC-ra-36 states.
